name: Quartino 2017 pertuzumab neoadjuvant PK/ER scenarios
description: Exact source replay plus source-limited dynamic pertuzumab PK shells for NeoSphere.

scenarios.name: Source status exact checks
scenarios.description: Source retrieval, citation, and route-audit values.

scenarios.name: NeoSphere design and baseline checks
scenarios.description: Arm definitions, baseline covariates, serum samples, and pCR counts from Table 1.

scenarios.name: PopPK and DDI exact checks
scenarios.description: Published PK structure, VPC/NPC setup, Ctrough ANOVA, and CL/Vc DDI p-values.

scenarios.name: Exposure-response exact checks
scenarios.description: Cycle 2 Ctrough target attainment, logit ER analysis population, and pCR slope p-value.

scenarios.name: Dose-selection exact checks
scenarios.description: Approved 840/420 mg q3w regimen, target trough threshold, and dose-selection context.

scenarios.name: Typical NeoSphere 840/420 mg q3w four-cycle PK shell
scenarios.description: Source-limited deterministic PK shell for the approved neoadjuvant regimen; not a patient-level VPC reproduction.

scenarios.name: Historical reference covariates 840/420 mg q3w
scenarios.description: Reference covariate dynamic shell using historical PopPK median LBW and albumin.
